resources.string: Prevents AppLock from being uninstalled without your PIN. AppLock claims no other powers: it cannot erase your phone, change your screen lock, or restrict the camera.

Lets AppLock detect when a protected app is opened so it can show the lock screen. AppLock reads only the package name of the app in the foreground. Nothing is recorded, stored off-device, or transmitted.
